containerOverrides.name: api
command: import os, psycopg2; db_url = os.environ['DATABASE_URL']; master_url = db_url.replace('postgresql+asyncpg', 'postgresql').replace('/appdb', '/postgres'); print('Connecting to master database...'); conn = psycopg2.connect(master_url); conn.autocommit = True; cur = conn.cursor(); cur.execute('CREATE DATABASE appdb;'); print('Database appdb created successfully!'); cur.close(); conn.close()
